title: Length of the evaluated value list
statement: For every modulus $k\in\mathbb{N}$, assignment $a:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, finite list $gs$ of arithmetic gates, and initial list $vs$ of natural numbers, evaluating the gates in order and appending their values increases the list length by exactly the number of gates: the resulting list has length $|vs|+|gs|$.
